_note: Wave 5b V3, helicopter supports (HeliSupports, HeliCall). Everything here is Proposed. upgrades: the air wing's one-time campaign purchases (HeliUpgrades), in the order the Motor pool page lists them. Prices are in data/prices.json "supports" (Economy.server_pay_support). cooldown_s: after a call, how long before that support can be called again. resupply: the pallet's load (HeliSupports.resupply_load): per_weapon gives, for every weapon the squad carries (players and squad AI, primary and sidearm), its magazines ([mags, loose rounds of that calibre]); fixed lists the rest as [item id, count]; pallet is the item it all sits on.

upgrades.name: Razorback heavy-lift VTOL
upgrades.text: Transport, extraction and helicopter insertion fly the Razorback: more troops than the Petrel (and room for two heavy exos), and a heavier hull. Resupply, medevac and cargo stay on the Petrel. A lost Razorback costs more to replace.

upgrades.name: Armoured cabin kit
upgrades.text: Spall liners and armoured crew seats on every support aircraft: hits do 30% less damage.

upgrades.name: Fast turnaround crews
upgrades.text: A second ground crew at the FOB refuels and rearms faster: every support can be called again 40% sooner.

resupply._note: Captain, 2026-10-16: enough for everyone, by role. per_weapon: mags and loose rounds for EACH soldier's weapon; per_head: for each soldier; per_role: extra for a soldier of that role; fixed: once.
